candidate_data.name_de: Grossbritannien: NHS-KI-Tool Annie von Anima Health erfindet Diabetes- und Herzdiagnosen fuer Londoner Patienten
candidate_data.name_en: UK: NHS AI tool Annie by Anima Health fabricates diabetes and heart diagnoses for London patient
candidate_data.description_de: Ein Patient einer Londoner GP-Praxis stellte fest, dass das in seine Akte uebernommene KI-Summary von Anima Healths Tool Annie eine Diabetes-Diagnose und eine vermeintliche koronare Herzerkrankung erfunden hatte, obwohl er nur wegen Mandelentzuendung erschienen war. Er wurde daraufhin faelschlich zum Diabetes-Screening eingeladen. Das Tool ist bei der MHRA nur als Class-I-Medizinprodukt registriert; NHS England raeumte ein, dass die Hausarztpraxis das KI-Summary fehlerhaft in die Akte gespeichert hatte.
candidate_data.description_en: A patient at a London GP practice discovered that an AI-generated summary added to his record by Anima Health's tool Annie had fabricated a diabetes diagnosis and suspected coronary artery disease, despite him only attending for tonsillitis. He was subsequently invited to a diabetic screening based on the false data. The tool is registered with the UK MHRA only as a Class I medical device; NHS England conceded the GP practice had inadvertently saved the AI-generated version instead of a corrected one.

candidate_data.name_en: France: CNIL fines IQVIA 5 million euros for unlawful health data warehouses

Das Pharma-Analytics-Unternehmen hatte Daten aus rund 14.000 Apotheken (LRX-Warehouse) und tausenden Arztpraxen (EMR-Warehouse) ohne Patienten-Information verarbeitet, eigene Studien ausserhalb des Rechtsrahmens durchgefuehrt und unzureichende Sicherheitsmassnahmen wie fehlende Mehrfaktorauthentifizierung verwendet. Die CNIL stufte die angeblich anonymen Daten als pseudonymisiert ein.
candidate_data.description_en: On 26 May 2026, France's data protection authority CNIL fined IQVIA Operations France 5 million euros. The pharma analytics company had processed data from around 14,000 pharmacies (LRX warehouse) and thousands of doctors' practices (EMR warehouse) without informing patients, ran studies on its own behalf outside the legal framework, and used insufficient security measures including absent multi-factor authentication. The CNIL ruled the supposedly anonymous data was in fact pseudonymous.

Cegedim detected the intrusion in late 2025, filed a criminal complaint in October, but only disclosed publicly in early March 2026 - four months later - after France24's reporting.

Der Garante stellte fest, dass praediktive Medizin als eigenstaendige Verarbeitung gesonderte Zustimmung erfordert und ordnete die Loeschung der so gewonnenen Daten an.
candidate_data.description_en: Italy's data protection authority Garante fined three hospitals 55,000 euros each on 24 January 2023 for unlawfully using an AI system to risk-stratify patients. The systems profiled patients, predicted future pathologies and assigned them to risk groups and waiting-list priority classes - without explicit informed consent. The Garante ruled that predictive medicine is a separate processing activity requiring specific consent and ordered the erasure of all data obtained.

candidate_data.name_de: Grossbritannien: Ransomware-Angriff auf NHS-Pathologiedienstleister Synnovis trug zum Tod eines Patienten bei
candidate_data.name_en: UK: Ransomware attack on NHS pathology provider Synnovis contributed to a patient's death
candidate_data.description_de: Am 3. Juni 2024 verschluesselte die Ransomware-Gruppe Qilin Systeme bei Synnovis, einem Pathologie-Dienstleister mehrerer Londoner NHS-Trusts. Folge: rund 1.134 geplante Operationen und 2.194 ambulante Termine in den ersten 13 Tagen abgesagt; Bluttests teils nur 10 Prozent Kapazitaet. Im Juni 2025 bestaetigte NHS England, dass der Angriff ein mitwirkender Faktor beim Tod eines Patienten war. 400 GB Daten wurden veroeffentlicht. Auch wenn der Angriff selbst nicht KI-gesteuert war, traf er das automatisierte Pathologie-Backbone und ist Teil der breiteren Diskussion um KI-/IT-Abhaengigkeiten im Gesundheitswesen.
candidate_data.description_en: On 3 June 2024 the Qilin ransomware group encrypted systems at Synnovis, a pathology services provider for several London NHS trusts. As a result, around 1,134 planned operations and 2,194 outpatient appointments were cancelled in the first 13 days; blood testing fell to about 10% of normal capacity. In June 2025 NHS England confirmed the attack was a contributing factor in a patient's death. Some 400 GB of data was leaked. While not itself an AI attack, it struck the automated pathology backbone and feeds the wider debate over AI/IT dependency in healthcare.

researcher_notes: Confidence sehr hoch. Vor Promote pruefen, ob das Incident-Type-Vokabular passt (Hauptpunkt ist Kombi aus Cyberangriff + Auswirkung auf algorithmus-basierte Lab-Infrastruktur). Privacy advocates pointed to re-identification risks. The NHS Data Protection Officer is reviewing the project.

candidate_data.name_de: Suedkorea: Lunit-INSIGHT-MMG uebersieht in koreanischer Studie 14 Prozent invasiver Brustkrebse
candidate_data.name_en: South Korea: Lunit INSIGHT MMG misses 14% of invasive breast cancers in Korean study
candidate_data.description_de: Eine in Radiology veroeffentlichte retrospektive Studie der Korea University College of Medicine analysierte 1.097 invasive Brustkrebsfaelle der Jahre 2014-2020 mit der kommerziellen KI-Mammografie-Software Lunit INSIGHT MMG (Version 1.1.7.3). Die KI verfehlte 14 Prozent (154 von 1.097) der invasiven Krebse - insbesondere bei juengeren Frauen, kleineren Tumoren, dichtem Brustgewebe und Tumoren ausserhalb der Mammazonen. Die luminalen Subtypen wurden in 17,2 Prozent uebersehen. Studie hat unmittelbare Patientensicherheits-Relevanz fuer Screening-Programme in Korea, USA und UK.
candidate_data.description_en: A retrospective study by Korea University College of Medicine, published in Radiology in 2025, analysed 1,097 invasive breast cancer cases from 2014-2020 using the commercial AI mammography software Lunit INSIGHT MMG (version 1.1.7.3). The AI missed 14% (154 of 1,097) of invasive cancers - particularly in younger women, smaller tumours, dense breast tissue, and tumours outside the glandular area. Luminal-subtype cancers were missed in 17.2% of cases. The study has immediate patient-safety relevance for screening programmes in Korea, the US and UK.

Ada triaged 34% correctly, undertriaged 13% and overtriaged 53%.

Hospitals routinely insisted on Aadhaar verification; people with broken biometric records waited weeks for corrections.

candidate_data.description_en: On 28 April 2021 South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) for the first time sanctioned an AI technology company: 103.3 million won (about USD 92,900) against ScatterLab for the chatbot Iruda. ScatterLab had used some 9.4 billion KakaoTalk messages from 600,000 users of its apps Text At and Science of Love to develop and operate Iruda - without deleting or encrypting personal information such as names, mobile numbers and addresses. candidate_data.description_en: On 13 November 2024 the French Conseil d'Etat rejected InterHop's emergency appeal against the CNIL authorisation of Microsoft Azure hosting for the Health Data Hub; on 19 November 2024 it dismissed claims against the EMC2 project. Cleyrop and Clever Cloud had challenged the failure to migrate to a sovereign solution - promised by the government in 2020. The court relied on multiple pseudonymisation steps and limited technical US-bound data flows, but implicitly acknowledged that the health data of 60+ million French citizens remains subject to US cloud law. A transitional solution is only expected to deploy in early 2026.
